title: Implement native DOS INT 21h AH=35h/AH=25h vector services
description: The Python DOS host models DOS Get/Set Interrupt Vector, but the native C callback traps both services. Add native per-host storage for 256 DOS vectors. AH=35h returns the stored segment:offset in ES:BX; AH=25h stores DS:DX under AL. Unknown vectors start at 0000:0000. Preserve upper register halves and carry semantics consistently with the existing Python service contract; keep unrelated vectors and per-host state isolated.
acceptance: Native AH=35h returns the configured ES:BX and zero for an unassigned vector
Native AH=25h stores DS:DX only for AL-selected vector and round-trips through AH=35h
Upper register halves, unrelated vectors, per-host separation, and CF-clear success are tested
Unknown DOS services remain trapped and native DPMI/stream plus Python DOS suites pass
